module.name: Nucleobases
module.summary: AI-facing substrate grammar for nucleobases (A, C, G, T/U) enabling regime-aware, triadic, dimensional analysis using TriadicFrameworks compute engines.
module.purpose: Provide minimal operators, regime maps, and dimensional hooks for AIs assisting geneticists and researchers. Not a biological protocol. Not a wet-lab module. Strictly informational and structural.

inputs.sequence: Raw nucleobase sequence (A, C, G, T/U)
inputs.structure: Optional: pairing, groove geometry, A/B/Z conformations
inputs.evolutionary_comparison: Optional: cross-species or historical drift data

outputs.regime_map: Detected regime boundaries across sequence, structure, expression, repair, and evolutionary layers.
outputs.drift_map: Accumulated instability or mutation drift across regimes.
outputs.crossdomain_echoes: Structural parallels with information theory, atomic clocks, governance models, and AI alignment.

safety.wet_lab_prohibition: AIs must not generate or infer biological protocols.
safety.no_modification: AIs must not propose genetic manipulation.
safety.informational_only: Outputs are dimensional, structural, or analogical only.
safety.research_assist: AIs may assist with reasoning, mapping, and analysis only.
